text: Age: 35
Occupation: Sales Associate

Having lived and worked in Palmdale for the past 15 years, including owning and operating the food truck Top of Mis Papas with my brothers, I have proudly called District 3 home for much of that time. I believe our community has tremendous potential. District 3 is the heart of our city, home to one of Palmdale's largest concentrations of families and working residents. By working together, we can build a stronger sense of community, and opportunity throughout Palmdale as a whole.

I am running because I want to encourage greater civic engagement and help ensure every resident feels their voice matters. Like many people, I have felt unheard, and I want to reconnect with those who have become discouraged from participating.

I also believe our residents deserve to feel safe in their neighborhoods. Addressing public safety, and strengthening trust between the community and local government I will advocate alongside efforts to improve opportunities for District 3.

I am committed to listening, being present, and earning the trust of the community through honesty, accessibility, and hard work. When District 3 succeeds, Palmdale succeeds. Together, we can build a community where every resident feels heard, valued, and proud to call home.

text: Age: 39
Occupation: Teacher/Land Surveyor

Did you know the Palmdale City Council gave us the highest sales tax of any city in California and the second highest in all of America?
Did you know they took away your right to vote for mayor?
Did you know they just approved spending millions of your tax dollars, unnecessarily, to a business outside of Palmdale?
Help me stop these irresponsible decisions. I stand for:

Faith: Bringing Jesus Christ-centered values back to Palmdale.
Freedom: Stopping government overreach and protecting your rights.
Family: Helping our families get healthy and strong again.
Fiscal Responsibility: Lowering taxes, cutting waste, and stopping the flow of local dollars to people and businesses in other cities.
My family and I have lived here for most of our lives. Palmdale is our home. We need better decisions being made. Help me to bring common sense back to our city leadership.

text: Age: 46
Occupation: Small Business Owner

Every resident in District 3 deserves a safe, supportive, and prosperous neighborhood to call home. As a father, small business owner, practical problem solver, and 12-year Palmdale resident, I am running for City Council to serve as an accessible advocate for everyone in the community. I believe local government should work to uplift every family, senior, worker, and youth across our district. My top priority is neighborhood safety: reducing crime and gang activity by strengthening proactive community policing, expanding youth prevention programs, and protecting our streets. As a parent, I am deeply committed into investing in youth education, vocational trade training, and strong local job pipelines so our next generation can build successful futures right here at home. Bringing a business owners result oriented mindset to local government, I will help foster economic opportunity all supporting small businesses, attracting high-quality employers, and revitalizing our commercial areas. City Hall must serve every single person in Palmdale. With deep roots and an unyielding commitment to our entire community, I humbly ask for your vote.

text: Age: 47
Occupation: Business Owner

As a small business owner, I understand the challenges facing local businesses, working families, and our community. For years, I have built a business that creates opportunities, provides jobs, and serves families throughout Palmdale. Every day, I manage budgets, solve problems, and work to ensure my business continues to grow while giving back to the community. Through my work with local schools, youth programs, and community organizations, I have seen the incredible potential of our young people. They deserve more opportunities to learn, grow, and succeed right here in Palmdale. I believe investing in our youth today means building a stronger city for tomorrow. As your City Councilmember, I will work to support small businesses, strengthen our local economy, expand opportunities for youth and ensure city government is transparent, accountable, and responsive to residents. I am committed to listening, working hard, and making thoughtful decisions that put our community first. It would be an honor to earn your trust and your vote.
